newsitem.title: USA: United Media to buy Bright Now Inc.
newsitem.headline: United Media to buy Bright Now Inc.

text.p: United Media Group Inc said Monday that it signed a letter of intent for the contingent purchase of all outstanding stock of privately-held Bright Now Inc for $2.5 million in cash and stock.
The deal is subject to the completion of a detailed agreement, United Media said, and is expected to be completed by August 18.
Both parties have the right to terminate the agreement 18 months from the date of the close if certain conditions are not met by United Media or Bright Now, United Media said.
